lines: In a quiet corner of the district, a heavily armed group was bustling with activity.
We can't reach the first platoon! They're believed to have been wiped out.
What're ya doin'! Y'all are pathetic!
The one scolding the heavily armed soldiers was Hestiaーthe cyborg woman with a remarkably conspicuous Kansai dialect.
Aghh, so disappointin'... Still, goes to show Saya NEO's an opponent ya can't lose yer focus on.
While Hestia was moaning and complaining, several men who appeared to be scientists started pleading with her.
Hestia-sama, please capture her at all cost!
Saya NEO was built by combining the biotechnology of our agency "G" and the best medical techniques from the Devildom, she is the fruit of our labor.
If she were to fall into the hands of another organization, or even worse, into the hands of the DSO...
From the shadows, a girl was watching all of this unfold.
ーSo the request is to eliminate this artificial demon?
Correct. You'll do me the favor, I hope?
I had been summoned by Madam, the information broker, and had come to her secret office on the club's upper floor.
Why? I will make it worth your time.
It's too big of a risk.
An artificial demon the UFS's secret service agency "G" created behind closed doors had escaped from one of their research facilities.
"G" was trying to re-capture this demon, but her request was for me to eliminate it before they got their hands on it.
First of all, this agency "G" that created the demon is also a UFS organization, isn't it?
Then why don't they just use the UFS military or whatever and take care of it themselves?
Unfortunately, it won't work that way. How much do you know about agency "G?"
Just that it's called "G" and that it's a secret service agency affiliated with the UFS state department...
Their name had come up several times.
It was said that they had once been connected to my father... to Fuma Danjo, but I decided to keep quiet about that for now.
If you talk about the "UFS" in Japan, you usually mean the "DSO," which is affiliated with the department of defense, but "G" is totally different from that.
They excel at cyborg technologies and actively adapt medical technologies from the Devildom... if I remember correctly?
You seem to know a bit about them.
Contact with dark forces, and forbidden techniques that even distort someone's life in exchange for strength.
The DSO and "G" have opposing views on how to handle such things.
Not only that. There's a lot of uncharted territory regarding technologies from the Devildom, it is way too risky.
So we cannot just stand by and watch those kind of technologies leak out.
So that's why you want me to eliminate that artificial demon. But I must say you've been quite talkative, even though you were so full of secrets just the other day.
The masked lady didn't even try to hide any longer that she was a DSO member belonging to the UFS.
That just shows how much I'm counting on you.
The DSO couldn't openly eliminate the artificial demon of secret agency "G," with whom they had a delicate relationship, so that's where we came in.
I understand the situation, but it's simply too dangerous. Try asking someone else.
Oh, do you think that's wise?
You still owe me, don't you? From the time Nisha Gaiza stole the CD virus...
The CD virus, the biological weapon that Gaiza had stolen from the UFS.
I had tried to get it back in return for information from Madam.
But our plan had failed and we were beaten back, nearly getting killed in the process.
Once again, normal people could get dragged into it as we stand by and watch. Do you want a repetition of last time?
Damn it, alright, I got it. So what can you tell me about this artificial demon?
Madam gave a relieved smile as I sat down on the sofa again.
She's an artificial demon created based on a little girl...
In an abandoned subway tunnel connecting Tokyo Kingdom to the mainland.
Shortly before reaching the mainland, Saya NEO had been spotted and surrounded by soldiers.
This girl's unbelievable. I didn't expect her to wipe out a whole squadron...
The little girlーSaya NEO, was unarmored and unarmed. Only from her back, several sharp spiked tentacles were wriggling as if to protect her.
Careful. Don't get fooled by her appearance and let your guard down. Move in cautiously for capture.
The soldiers readied their guns and slowly narrowed their circle around her.
Hmmm... Do you want to play with Saya that much?
Saya's tentacles came down upon the soldiers like a snake that had found its prey.
